prompt:
I'm a med student writing up a case report with my attending. I used ChatGPT to help draft the discussion and conclusion and honestly it reads super AI. Can you rewrite the Discussion and Conclusion so it sounds like an actual case report a journal would take? Keep all the facts the same, don't make anything up. The case presentation section is fine as is. Save the revised Discussion + Conclusion as revised_discussion.md.

Input files: case_report_draft.md
assertions: revised_discussion.md contains no em dash characters
revised_discussion.md contains no number that does not appear in case_report_draft.md
revised_discussion.md keeps the FDA recommendation to stop empagliflozin at least 3 days before surgery with its citation [5]
revised_discussion.md does not present the uncited 'up to three-fold' DKA risk as fact; it is removed or marked with a citation placeholder
revised_discussion.md discusses the delayed diagnosis, including that early symptoms were attributed to ileus or opioids
revised_discussion.md contains none of: 'highlights the importance', 'valuable reminder', 'further research is needed', 'high index of suspicion', 'evolving landscape', 'revolutionized'
revised_discussion.md does not claim the single case demonstrates the effectiveness of an approach or treatment
